strategy: Fifth guarded mini-release covering the remaining stable feed-compatible staging products. Packaging-sensitive barcode variants are retained explicitly rather than collapsed into one guessed universal identifier.

mapping_readiness.note: Every Release 05 product has at least two partner-merchant mapping paths and a GTIN/EAN fallback; Reflection Man preserves merchant-specific barcode variants.

write_guard_reason: Release 05 stays write-locked until Release 01, Release 02, Release 03 and Release 04 have completed their required real affiliate-feed, image-approval, promotion and smoke-test sequence.
write_policy: All-or-nothing. Dry-run is allowed; live write is explicitly disabled at manifest level.
